<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

<!-- PR title: [Type] scope: title, or [Type] [Hardware] scope: title.
Type: Feat, Fix, Refactor, Perf, Doc, Test, CI, or Chore.
Scope: any module or model name (no fixed list or letter-case restriction), e.g. attention, qwen3, or flash-attn.
Hardware: optional single tag without spaces. Use uppercase hardware tags (AMD, NVIDIA, NPU, MI300X), except for exactly these four spellings: Intel, Apple, Huawei, Ascend.
Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

<!-- Describe the purpose and goals of this pull request. -->

On DSV4.1 with TP only, the draft's head are split by vocab. Each GPU computes logits for its own slice, and picking a draft token never needs the whole vocab.

But verify runs rejection sampling over the whole vocab, so the draft all-gathers its logits at every step, once per draft token.

This PR keeps the draft logits on their shards and adds a support to sharded rejection sampling, so verify only exchanges a few statistics per row instead of the whole-vocab logits.

## Modifications

<!-- Detail the changes made in this pull request. -->

**Gating**
- Add `SGLANG_DSPARK_SHARDED_ACCEPT`, on by default on HIP.
- With the flag off, nothing changes.

**Draft side**
- With the sharded accept on, the draft keeps each step's logits on its own vocab shard instead of all-gathering them.

  ```python
  # python/sglang/srt/speculative/dspark_components/dspark_worker_v2.py, L328
  # Use the sharded accept only when the vocab is sharded and logits are kept.
  self._sharded_accept = (
      envs.SGLANG_DSPARK_SHARDED_ACCEPT.get()
      and not self._greedy_draft
      and markov_head is not None
      and markov_head.vocab_shard is not None
  )

  # python/sglang/srt/speculative/dspark_components/dspark_draft.py, L224
  sharded = (
      {}
      if shard is None
      else dict(
          vocab_start=shard.start,
          gather=shard.gather.gather_stacked,
          gather_logits=None if sharded_accept else shard.gather,  # skip the all-gather
      )
  )
  ```

- Pass the draft's noise to the verify, so every rank reaches the same accept decision and bonus token.

**Verify side**
- Add `sharded_accept_hip.py` with two triton kernels:
  - `_stats_kernel`: each gpu reduces its vocab shard to a few stats per row (max logit, sum-exp, the drafted token's logit).
  - `_accept_kernel`: each gpu merges the stats into p(x) and q(x) and runs the accept test. The bonus is a Gumbel-max race on each shard. The gpus exchange their candidates, and the draft's existing finish kernel picks the token.
- `accept_draft_tokens`: temperature-only batches use the sharded accept. Top-k, top-p, or block verification gather the logits once and fall back to `AcceptSampling`, matching main.

**Other**
- `dspark_block_accept_estimator.py`, `dspark_observability.py`: the block accept estimator (a diagnostic tool, off by default) skips sharded logits instead of computing on half the vocab.

## Accuracy Tests

<!-- If this pull request affects model outputs (e.g., changes to the kernel or model forward code), provide accuracy test results. -->

 **GSM8K**:

| Temperature | Sharded accept off | Sharded accept on |
|---|---|---|
| 1.0 | 85.7% | 86.3% |
| 0.0 | 90.4% | 90.2% |

**Accept length** is unchanged: 
- Client: in/out=8k/1k, temperature=1.0
- Server: tp2, no radix-cache

| Concurrency | Sharded accept off | Sharded accept on |
|---|---|---|
| 4  | 4.43 | 4.48 |
| 16 | 4.37 | 4.54 |
| 64 | 4.49 | 4.54 |

## Speed Tests and Profiling

<!-- If this pull request impacts inference speed, provide benchmarking and profiling results. -->

**Fixed length workload**
- Client: in/out=8k/1k, temperature=1.0
- Server: tp2, no radix-cache

> Real mode

| Concurrency | Sharded accept | Median TTFT (ms) | Median ITL (ms) | TTT (tok/s) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 4 | off | 208.9 | 2.27 | 9,629 |
| 4 | on | 208.9 | 2.21 (-2.6%) | 9,832 (+2.1%) |
| 16 | off | 227.6 | 4.09 | 16,442 |
| 16 | on | 250.5 | 3.89 (-4.9%) | 17,869 (+8.7%) |
| 64 | off | 692.3 | 8.29 | 27,238 |
| 64 | on | 687.8 | 7.90 (-4.7%) | 27,995 (+2.8%) |

> SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_LEN=3.51

| Concurrency | Sharded accept | Median TTFT (ms) | Median ITL (ms) | TTT (tok/s) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 4 | off | 210.3 | 3.27 | 8,386 |
| 4 | on | 209.5 | 3.22 (-1.5%) | 8,439 (+0.6%) |
| 16 | off | 461.3 | 5.79 | 16,123 |
| 16 | on | 596.6 | 5.64 (-2.6%) | 16,375 (+1.6%) |
| 64 | off | 864.8 | 11.80 | 25,424 |
| 64 | on | 466.8 | 11.39 (-3.5%) | 25,975 (+2.2%) |

**Agentx workload**: concurrency 64, simulated accept length 3.51

| | Sharded accept off | Sharded accept on | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| TTT per GPU (tok/s) | 146,675 | 151,863 | +3.5% |
| P90 interactivity (tok/s/user) | 45.65 | 48.64 | +6.6% |

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

@@ -0,0 +1,287 @@
+"""
+DSpark rejection sampling with the draft logits on the TP vocab shards.
+
+The rule is ``AcceptSampling``'s without block verification: draft token x is
+accepted when u * q(x) < p(x), p and q being the target's and the draft's
+temperature softmax; the first rejection draws the bonus from max(p - q, 0), a
+fully accepted chain from the last row's p.
+
+No rank holds the whole draft vocab.
+
+The bonus follows AcceptSampling's distribution.
+"""
+
+from typing import Callable, Optional
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+from triton.language.extra import libdevice
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.speculative.dspark.markov_sample import (
+    _markov_sample_finish_kernel,
+)
+
+_BLOCK = 4096
+_ACCEPT_STEP, _BONUS_STEP = tl.constexpr(0xFFFFFFFE), tl.constexpr(0xFFFFFFFF)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _fold(m, s, x):
+    """Fold block ``x`` into the running (max, sum of exp(v - max))."""
+    new_m = tl.maximum(m, tl.max(x, 0))
+    ref = tl.where(new_m == -float("inf"), 0.0, new_m)
+    return new_m, s * tl.exp(m - ref) + tl.sum(tl.exp(x - ref), 0)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _merge(m, s):
+    """Merge the ranks' (max, sum-exp) pairs along axis 1."""
+    big = tl.max(m, 1)
+    ref = tl.where(big == -float("inf"), 0.0, big)
+    return big, tl.sum(s * tl.exp(m - ref[:, None]), 1)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _philox(KEY, c0, row, step, OFFSET):
+    """Philox words at (c0, row, step, block counter), the draft's counters."""
+    lane = tl.zeros(c0.shape, tl.int64)
+    return tl.philox(
+        KEY,
+        c0.to(tl.uint32),
+        (lane + row).to(tl.uint32),
+        (lane + step).to(tl.uint32),
+        ((lane + tl.load(OFFSET)) & 0xFFFFFFFF).to(tl.uint32),
+    )
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _stats_kernel(
+    TARGET,
+    DRAFT,
+    CAND,
+    TEMP,
+    STATS,
+    TARGET_S,
+    START,
+    WIDTH,
+    PADDED,
+    SLOTS: tl.constexpr,
+    GAMMA: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    """
+    Row r over this rank's vocab slice, logits divided by the temperature,
+    target then draft: (max logit, sum-exp, drafted token's logit). The drafted
+    token's logit is -inf when another rank holds it.
+    """
+    r = tl.program_id(0)
+    b, i = r // SLOTS, r % SLOTS
+    has_x = i < SLOTS - 1
+    inv_t = 1.0 / tl.maximum(tl.load(TEMP + b), 1e-5)
+    target = TARGET + r.to(tl.int64) * TARGET_S + START
+    draft = DRAFT + (b * GAMMA + i).to(tl.int64) * PADDED
+    t_m, t_s, d_m, d_s = -float("inf"), 0.0, -float("inf"), 0.0
+    for k in range(0, WIDTH, BLOCK):
+        j = k + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+        t = tl.load(target + j, j < WIDTH, -float("inf")).to(tl.float32)
+        d = tl.load(draft + j, has_x & (j < WIDTH), -float("inf")).to(tl.float32)
+        t_m, t_s = _fold(t_m, t_s, t * inv_t)
+        d_m, d_s = _fold(d_m, d_s, d * inv_t)
+    x = tl.load(CAND + r + 1, has_x, -1) - START
+    own = has_x & (x >= 0) & (x < WIDTH)
+    out = STATS + r * 6
+    tl.store(out, t_m)
+    tl.store(out + 1, t_s)
+    tl.store(out + 2, tl.load(target + x, own, -float("inf")).to(tl.float32) * inv_t)
+    tl.store(out + 3, d_m)
+    tl.store(out + 4, d_s)
+    tl.store(out + 5, tl.load(draft + x, own, -float("inf")).to(tl.float32) * inv_t)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _accept_kernel(
+    STATS,
+    TARGET,
+    DRAFT,
+    CAND,
+    TEMP,
+    VERIFY_LENS,
+    KEY,
+    OFFSET,
+    LENS,
+    PARTIAL,
+    BS,
+    TARGET_S,
+    START,
+    WIDTH,
+    PADDED,
+    PARTS,
+    SLOTS: tl.constexpr,
+    SLOTS_P2: tl.constexpr,
+    GAMMA: tl.constexpr,
+    WORLD: tl.constexpr,
+    WORLD_P2: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_CUTOFF: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    """
